description: STRIP entropy (blend, alpha 0.7, N = 100) per input on the representative CICIDS2017 benign-target MLP (causal_ids_B_imbal_tgtBenign_seed42): (a) histogram (outline, 60 bins) and Gaussian KDE reflected at 0 (entropy >= 0) per group, (b) ROC of triggered vs clean benign inputs (lower entropy = more suspicious). Same data as the article's Figure 2.

values.note: roc_auc is computed from the 6-decimal CSV; roc_auc_reference is the full-precision value in phase7f
